links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses (FRE, FKGL) across models
links.effect: Gemini 2.0 Flash produced the most accessible responses; DeepSeek-R1 was significantly less readable (p = 0.012). GPT-3.5 MCQs easier to read than open-ended (p = 0.027).
links.quote: In terms of readability, Gemini 2.0 Flash consistently produced the most accessible responses, while DeepSeek-R1 was significantly less readable (p = 0.012).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates multiple commercial LLMs on dental anesthesia questions for accuracy, safety, and readability using expert clinician raters and readability metrics without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
